cause: After the sidepanel verified an admin sign-in, useAuth broadcast AUTH_STATE_CHANGED. The native message bus synchronously delivers broadcasts to listeners in the sending document. Every mounted useAuth listener treated its own notice as an external auth transition and called applyCanonicalSession, which clears isAdmin before an asynchronous role check. During that interval App renders the 17 non-admin navigation entries despite Settings having already shown admin readiness.
source_evidence: src/hooks/use-auth.ts: signIn published AUTH_STATE_CHANGED after successful admin check, while its listener called applyCanonicalSession
src/config/sidepanel-visibility.ts: four navigation tabs require isAdmin, yielding exactly 17 when that flag is temporarily false
change: Suppress only this hook's own synchronous local AUTH_STATE_CHANGED delivery. Other extension contexts still receive the notice; notices originating elsewhere still cause session and role revalidation. The same suppression covers sign-out's redundant local notification.
